responsibility: Implements the D front end’s checked fixed-width integer arithmetic helpers. This file provides the executable primitives for signed and unsigned addition, subtraction, negation, and multiplication on 32-bit and 64-bit integers, returning the truncated machine-width result while setting a sticky overflow flag when the mathematical result is not representable. It serves as a small semantic utility layer used where the imported DMD code needs overflow-aware integral computation without invoking undefined behavior, supplying the concrete arithmetic and overflow-detection logic declared in `checkedint.h`.
same_name_distinction: This is the implementation file in the checkedint pair: it defines the actual overflow-detecting arithmetic routines for 32-bit and 64-bit signed and unsigned operations, including the overflow tests and sticky-flag updates declared by `gcc/d/dmd/checkedint.h`.
